status_map.PASS: counts toward totals; all-PASS + verdict PASS → gate passed
status_map.FAIL: any failed case → deny (N failed case(s)); suite timeout synthesizes a FAIL case (Program.cs) → counted failure → deny
status_map.BLOCKED: classified via suite_criticality.json → blocked_classifications; release-critical/unregistered/missing-registry → deny; experimental-only → incomplete_evidence=true, passed=true (INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE ≠ clean PASS — recorded, never counted as PASS)
status_map.TIMEOUT: orchestrator-level run budget (120s) → deny run-budget-exceeded; per-suite timeout → FAIL case → deny
status_map.STALE: stale binaries/manifest → one bounded rebuild (auto_build) else deny; missing/empty manifest revision → stale → deny; report-missing → deny; 0 cases → deny

phase4_push_gate_semantics.verified: verdict not in {PASS,INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE} → deny fail-closed (unknown verdicts never promoted); revision_match binds manifest revision to HEAD
phase4_push_gate_semantics.csharp_no_overwrite: orchestrator deletes only the PREVIOUS run's per-suite json then the suite regenerates it; consolidated report is a separate file (native-orchestration-report.json); raw per-suite evidence never overwritten by aggregation
phase4_push_gate_semantics.release_semantics: FAIL/TIMEOUT/STALE → push denied ⇒ VERIFIED_RELEASE unreachable; BLOCKED → INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE ⇒ no complete VERIFIED_RELEASE
